name: Payments from overseas
description: A contents/index page covering the topic of payments from overseas, including overseas pensions, reciprocal agreements, exchange rates, couples receiving overseas pensions, interactions with New Zealand Superannuation and Veterans Pension, and related taxation and accommodation supplement considerations.
